status: implemented and locally verified for M2; hosted migration and backend secret/deployment remain external gates

physicalSchema.strategy: durable measurement_jobs plus typed measurements and typed per-index child rows
physicalSchema.legacyTable: lahan_health remains read-only legacy and is not a measured-data source
physicalSchema.provenanceExtension: jsonb for provider-specific non-canonical metadata only

workerRuntime.strategy: authenticated Node backend worker; Catalog discovers the latest acquisition, then two same-acquisition Process API requests preserve NDVI 10 m and NDMI 20 m native output grids
workerRuntime.responsePerNativeGrid: each Process request returns its raster and userdata source metadata together
workerRuntime.crossRequestInvariant: both native-grid responses must have identical scene IDs, data paths, product IDs, acquisition interval, and provider service version
workerRuntime.reason: acquisition, grid, source identity, persistence, retry, and idempotency must be explicit and independent of UI rendering

sourceIdentity.strategy: same-response CDSE Process API userdata for each native-grid raster, followed by strict source-identity matching
sourceIdentity.productIdDerivation: extract the .SAFE product identifier from each provider dataPath and retain the original dataPath plus shId in provider_provenance
sourceIdentity.catalogRole: availability discovery only; Catalog candidates are never persisted as proof of selected source pixels

geometryHash.normalization: close ring, round coordinates, canonicalize orientation and start vertex

processingGrid.strategy: project the exact polygon to its local UTM CRS before metre-based processing

processingVersions.versionBumpRule: bump when formula, SCL inclusion, rice-water handling, source-selection/mosaicking, resolution, resampling, aggregation, or pixel-accounting semantics change
